about: The Vale (OPEN-WORLD-BRIEF §4): a green and gold open country — grass #6F9A44, leaf #5F8A3C, pine #2F5A3A, packed-earth roads #6B5538, plaster #E2D8C0 and thatch #B8945A on the town, field stone #8A8578, sand #C7B07A at the pond, water #4F8A96. Slot 12 is the ground's grass; slot 1 the roads.
